quarterly_data.quarter: AIXTRON press release: AIXTRON Q3 2026: Order intake and operating profitability (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary Q3 2026 revenue was approximately EUR 184 million (Q3 2025: EUR 119.6 million), within the company's forecast range for the quarter of EUR 180 million plus or minus EUR 20 million; gross profit approximately EUR 87 million, a gross margin of approximately 48% (Q3 2025: EUR 46.4 million; 39%); EBIT approximately EUR 57 million, an EBIT margin of approximately 31% (Q3 2025: EUR 15.4 million; 13%). The company attributes its preliminary operating profitability in particular to a favorable product mix. The guidance for fiscal year 2026 remains unchanged.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue approximately EUR 184 million; gross margin approximately 48%; EBIT approximately EUR 57 million (approximately 31% margin)
